async function contentFarmFetch(
  configPath: string,
  upstream: FetchLike,
  onSkip: (message: string) => void,
): Promise<FetchLike> {
  const cable = await createKoiosNewscable(configPath, onSkip);
  return (async (input: Parameters<FetchLike>[0], init?: Parameters<FetchLike>[1]): Promise<Response> => {
    const raw = typeof input === "string" || input instanceof URL ? String(input) : input.url;
    const url = new URL(raw);
    const localCable = (url.hostname === "127.0.0.1" || url.hostname === "localhost") && url.port === "18809";
    if (!localCable) return upstream(input, init);
    const surface = await cable.handle(cable.domain, `${url.pathname}${url.search}`);
    return new Response(surface.body, { status: surface.status, headers: surface.headers });
  }) as FetchLike;
}

type JsonRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is JsonRecord {
  return !!value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function stringValue(value: unknown, fallback = ""): string {
  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== "" ? value.trim() : fallback;
}

function strings(value: unknown): readonly string[] {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === "") return Object.freeze([]);
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return Object.freeze(value.flatMap((item) => strings(item)));
  return Object.freeze([String(value)]);
}

function manuscriptSlug(frontMatter: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>, fallback: string): string {
  return typeof frontMatter["slug"] === "string" && frontMatter["slug"] !== "" ? frontMatter["slug"] : fallback;
}

function koiosFrontMatter(frontMatter: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>): Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const value = frontMatter["koios"];
  return isRecord(value) ? value : Object.freeze({});
}

function candidateState(contentDir: string | undefined, slug: string): SourceCycleCandidateState {
  if (contentDir === undefined || slug === "") return Object.freeze({ status: "missing" as const });
  const path = join(contentDir, `${slug}.md`);
  if (!existsSync(path)) return Object.freeze({ status: "missing" as const, path });
  const document = decodeFrontMatterDocument(readFileSync(path, "utf8"));
  const title = stringValue(document.frontMatter["title"]);
  return Object.freeze({
    status: document.frontMatter["draft"] === true ? "draft" as const : "published" as const,
    path,
    ...(title === "" ? {} : { title }),
  });
}

export function normalizeCandidateReferences(path: string): SourceCycleCandidateReferenceNormalization {
  const normalized = normalizeContentFarmCandidateReferences({
    path,
    license: KOIOS_DEFAULT_LICENSE,
    licenseUrl: KOIOS_DEFAULT_LICENSE_URL,
    syndicationRights: KOIOS_DEFAULT_SYNDICATION_RIGHTS,
  });
  // Minimal URL promotion cannot know an article title and therefore uses the
  // host name. Koios's own wire store does know it. Settle that locally before
  // the reference crosses the publication boundary.
  const storeRoot = join(dirname(dirname(dirname(resolve(path)))), "store");
  const titles = new Map<string, string>();
  const walk = (root: string): readonly string[] => {
    try { return readdirSync(root, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => entry.isDirectory() ? walk(join(root, entry.name)) : entry.name.endsWith(".json") ? [join(root, entry.name)] : []); }
    catch { return []; }
  };
  for (const sourcePath of walk(storeRoot)) {
    try {
      const bundle = JSON.parse(readFileSync(sourcePath, "utf8")) as JsonRecord;
      const claims = Array.isArray(bundle["claims"]) ? bundle["claims"] : [];
      let url = ""; let title = "";
      for (const claim of claims) {
        if (!isRecord(claim)) continue;
        const proposition = isRecord(claim["proposition"]) ? claim["proposition"] : {};
        if (proposition["predicate"] === "url" && typeof proposition["object"] === "string") url = proposition["object"];
        if (proposition["predicate"] === "title" && typeof proposition["object"] === "string") title = proposition["object"];
      }
      if (url !== "" && title !== "") titles.set(url.replace(/\/+$/, ""), title);
    } catch { /* malformed wire evidence is ignored by this projection */ }
  }
  const document = decodeFrontMatterDocument(readFileSync(path, "utf8"));
  const references = Array.isArray(document.frontMatter["references"])
    ? document.frontMatter["references"].map((reference) => {
        if (!isRecord(reference)) return reference;
        const url = typeof reference["URL"] === "string" ? reference["URL"].replace(/\/+$/, "") : "";
        const title = titles.get(url);
        return title === undefined ? reference : Object.freeze({ ...reference, title });
      })
    : [];
  const titleChanged = JSON.stringify(references) !== JSON.stringify(document.frontMatter["references"] ?? []);
  if (titleChanged) {
    writeFileSync(path, encodeFrontMatterDocument({
      kind: "producing-content.frontmatter-document" as const,
      frontMatter: Object.freeze({ ...document.frontMatter, references: Object.freeze(references) }),
      body: document.body.endsWith("\n") ? document.body : `${document.body}\n`,
    }), "utf8");
  }
  return Object.freeze({ ...normalized, changed: normalized.changed || titleChanged });
}

function compactDraftLinkSuggestion(suggestion: DraftInternalLinkSuggestion): SourceCycleCandidateDraftInternalLinkGuidance["suggestions"][number] {

}

export function enrichCandidateDraftInternalLinkGuidance(path: string, contentDir = dirname(path)): SourceCycleCandidateDraftInternalLinkGuidance {
  const document = decodeFrontMatterDocument(readFileSync(path, "utf8"));
  const slug = manuscriptSlug(document.frontMatter, path.replace(/^.*\//, "").replace(/\.md$/, ""));
  const koios = koiosFrontMatter(document.frontMatter);
  const term = stringValue(koios["seo_term"]) || strings(document.frontMatter["keywords"])[0] || stringValue(document.frontMatter["title"], slug);
  const beat = stringValue(koios["beat"]);
  const tags = strings(document.frontMatter["tags"]);
  const posts = loadPosts(contentDir);
  const guidance = draftInternalLinkGuidanceReading({
    posts,
    items: koiosItems(posts, koiosMasthead()),
    term,
    ...(beat === "" ? {} : { beat }),
    tags,
    excludeSlugs: [slug],
    limit: 3,
  });
  const suggestions = Object.freeze(guidance.suggestions.map(compactDraftLinkSuggestion));
  const nextKoios = Object.freeze({
    ...koios,
    draft_internal_link_guidance: suggestions,
  });
  const changed = JSON.stringify(koios["draft_internal_link_guidance"] ?? []) !== JSON.stringify(suggestions);
  if (changed) {
    writeFileSync(path, encodeFrontMatterDocument({
      kind: "producing-content.frontmatter-document" as const,
      frontMatter: Object.freeze({
        ...document.frontMatter,
        koios: nextKoios,
      }),
      body: document.body.endsWith("\n") ? document.body : `${document.body}\n`,
    }), "utf8");
  }
  return sourceCycleCandidateDraftInternalLinkGuidance({
    slug,
    path,
    changed,
    suggestions,
  });
}

function normalizeCycleCandidateReferences(cycle: FarmCycle, collisions: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set()): readonly SourceCycleCandidateReferenceNormalization[] {
  const normalized: SourceCycleCandidateReferenceNormalization[] = [];
  for (const reading of cycle.readings) {
    const run = reading.run;
    if (run.kind !== "content.farm.cultivation:witness" || run.path === null) continue;
    if (collisions.has(resolve(run.path))) continue;
    normalized.push(normalizeCandidateReferences(run.path));
  }
  return Object.freeze(normalized);
}

function enrichCycleCandidateDraftInternalLinks(cycle: FarmCycle, collisions: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set()): readonly SourceCycleCandidateDraftInternalLinkGuidance[] {
  const enriched: SourceCycleCandidateDraftInternalLinkGuidance[] = [];
  for (const reading of cycle.readings) {
    const run = reading.run;
    if (run.kind !== "content.farm.cultivation:witness" || run.path === null) continue;
    if (collisions.has(resolve(run.path))) continue;
    enriched.push(enrichCandidateDraftInternalLinkGuidance(run.path));
  }
  return Object.freeze(enriched);
}

export function koiosSourceCyclePlan(options: Pick<KoiosSourceCycleOptions, "configPath"> = {}): KoiosSourceCyclePlan {
  const configPath = options.configPath ?? DEFAULT_CONTENT_PRODUCTION_CONFIG;
  const document = readContentFarmConfigDocument(configPath);

    configPath,
    document,
    operator: Object.freeze({

      runUrl: "https://newsroom.koios.news/operators/source-cycle",
      publicationGate: "Draft candidates remain draft:true until the editing and publishing offices approve them.",
    }),

}

export async function runKoiosSourceCycle(options: KoiosSourceCycleOptions = {}): Promise<KoiosSourceCycleReading> {
  const configPath = options.configPath ?? DEFAULT_CONTENT_PRODUCTION_CONFIG;
  const plan = koiosSourceCyclePlan({ configPath });
  const skippedMessages: string[] = [];
  const onSkip = (message: string): void => {
    skippedMessages.push(message);
    options.onSkip?.(message);
  };
  if (options.fetchImpl !== undefined) throw new Error("custom in-process fetch cannot cross the separately executable newscable provider boundary; use a declared fixture source instead");
  const cableResults = refreshSourceCorpus({ configPath, dataDir: join(dirname(resolve(configPath)), "data"), now: (options.now ?? (() => new Date().toISOString()))() }).results;
  const farmFetch = await contentFarmFetch(configPath, options.fetchImpl ?? fetch, onSkip);
  const farmConfig = readContentFarmConfig(configPath);
  const snapshots = contentFarmCandidateSnapshots(farmConfig);
  const service = createContentFarmService(farmConfig, {
    fetchImpl: farmFetch,
    env: options.env ?? process.env,
    ...(options.views === undefined ? {} : { views: options.views }),
    ...(options.now === undefined ? {} : { now: options.now }),
  });
  const cycle = await service.tick();
  const candidateWriteCollisions = restoreContentFarmCandidateWriteCollisions(cycle, snapshots, {
    instruction: "The farm attempted to write a draft candidate at an existing manuscript path. Koios restored the existing manuscript; create a new assignment or unique draft slug before writing this candidate.",
  });
  const collisionPaths = contentFarmCollisionPathSet(candidateWriteCollisions);
  const candidateReferences = normalizeCycleCandidateReferences(cycle, collisionPaths);
  const candidateDraftInternalLinkGuidance = enrichCycleCandidateDraftInternalLinks(cycle, collisionPaths);
  const farm = farmCycleReading(cycle);
  return contentFarmSourceCycleReading({
    generatedAt: (options.now ?? (() => new Date().toISOString()))(),
    plan,
    cable: {
      wireCount: cableResults.length,
      written: cableResults.reduce((sum, result) => sum + result.written, 0),
      skipped: cableResults.reduce((sum, result) => sum + result.skipped, 0),
      errorCount: cableResults.reduce((sum, result) => sum + result.errors.length, 0),
      results: cableResults,
      skippedMessages,
    },
    farm,
    candidateWriteCollisions,
    candidateReferences,
    candidateDraftInternalLinkGuidance,
    editorialPolicy: {
      record: "draft-candidate" as const,
      publication: "independent-standards-and-editorial-contract" as const,
      note: "The source cycle can write draft candidates and run traces; Koios normalizes candidate citation metadata to CSL references and annotates drafts with same-site link guidance. Publication requires both deterministic standards and an exact-manuscript LISS editorial acceptance, without a per-article human gate.",
    },
  });
}

  return !!value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);

function claimValue(bundle: JsonRecord, predicate: string): string | undefined {
  const claims = Array.isArray(bundle["claims"]) ? bundle["claims"] : [];
  for (const claim of claims) {
    if (!isRecord(claim)) continue;
    const proposition = isRecord(claim["proposition"]) ? claim["proposition"] : {};
    if (proposition["predicate"] !== predicate) continue;
    const value = proposition["object"];
    if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== "") return value.trim();

  if (!isRecord(value)) throw new TypeError(`wire bundle is not an object: ${path}`);

# Researching a Koios.News story

The job is not to cover the biggest headline.
It is to find the event that is **under-discussed relative to how much it reveals** — the small fracture that is a clear window onto the larger emergent phenomenon.

## Process

1. **Scan the last 24 hours to 7 days** of news.
  Only use events you can confirm happened within the last week.
2. **Pick for revelation, not size.** Favour an event that (a) is not being widely discussed, and (b) connects cleanly to the collapse frame — climate breakdown as upstream cause, a compounding feedback rather than an isolated incident.
3. **Find the primary sources.** Get title, author, and permalink for each.
  You will cite these, not paraphrase them away.
4. **Name the synthetic frame** — the one sentence that says what larger system this event is a window onto.
5. **Choose the single SEO term.** One term the whole post will align to; it must read naturally in a first paragraph and in a subheader.
6. **Feasibility-check** any future the event implies: can the world actually support that adaptation at that point?

## Output: a research brief

Write a brief to `library/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md` (use the script).
It carries: the event, the confirmed primary sources, why it is under-discussed, the chosen SEO term, and the collapse-connection angle.
The brief is what `working/writing/` consumes.

## Working from a specific source

Sometimes the story starts the other way round: someone hands you ONE source — a think-tank dispatch, an investigation, a report — and asks whether it belongs in Koios.
The **submission desk** is for that.
It does not paraphrase the source into a post; it appraises beat fit, then *finds more* — pulling related items out of the beat's own wires (and any sources you already found by hand) — and synthesizes original, multi-source analysis anchored on the seed, through the same cultivation cycle every article runs through.

- A source outside every Koios beat is witnessed as out-of-frame and never drafted (the same lawful shape as unsupported demand).
- The seed leads; related wire matches and your discoveries are the supporting context the analysis draws on.
  Aim for several real sources cited, not one.
- The draft candidate is a starting point, not the post.
  A single-source LLM rewrite is slop; the editor's job is the original synthesis across the gathered sources, with every figure and claim warranted.

Take a brief from `working/researching/library/` and turn it into a publishable draft in `content/posts/`.
Write in Nik's voice (see `AGENTS.md`).

## Shape of the article

- **Lede (first paragraph):** state the event plainly and land the **SEO term** in it.

  Never paraphrase a source's argument away.
- **Close:** tie the event into the larger compounding pattern.
  A vision, never a prophecy — "might", not "will".

- `summary` — a ~50-word excerpt, SEO term included.
- `description` — a ~120-character meta description for link previews.

# Editing a Koios.News post

Nothing ships until it passes here.
Two layers: the mechanical checks (run the linter) and the judgment checks (you, reading as Nik).

## Mechanical — run the linter

`scripts/lint-post.mjs content/posts/<slug>.md` checks:

- body length ≥ 800 words;
- the SEO term (`koios.seo_term`) appears in the **first paragraph**;
- the SEO term appears in **at least one `##` subheader**;
- `summary` (~50 words), `description` (~120 chars), and `koios.tweet` are all present and non-empty;
- reports the `draft` state.

It exits non-zero if a hard check fails.
Fix and re-run until clean.

## Judgment — read it as Nik

- **Voice.** Confident-but-comfortable, content-farm register, concise.
  No hedging filler, no academic throat-clearing.
  One or two examples, not a pile.
- **Citations.** Every claim that needs a source has one, by title/author/ permalink, linked inline.
  No source's argument paraphrased away.
- **No prophecy.** Scan for "will happen" / certainty about the future.
  A vision is "might", not "will".
  Rewrite anything that predicts.
- **Not isolated.** Every section connects the event to the larger compounding phenomenon.
  Cut any paragraph that treats it as a one-off.

/** The assignment-editor prompt: from today's intake, name the N strongest
 * distinct story angles worth assigning. */
export function assignmentPrompt(voice: string, topic: string, articles: readonly SyndicationItem[], max = 3): string {
  const publication = articles.map((article, index) => `${index + 1}. ${article.title}`).join("\n");
  return `${voice.replace(/\{topic\}/g, topic)}\n\nHere is today's source intake. Name the ${max} strongest distinct story angles worth assigning, one per line.\n\nSource observations:\n${publication}`;
}

/** Read the assignment editor's reply into clean angle lines, dropping
 * preamble, empty headers, and numbering. */
export function parseAngles(reply: unknown): readonly string[] {
  return Object.freeze(String(reply ?? "").split("\n")
    .map((line) => cleanProse(line.replace(/^[\s>*\-\d.)]+/, "")))
    .filter((line) => line.length > 4 && /[a-z]/i.test(line))
    .filter((line) => !/:\s*$/.test(line))
    .filter((line) => !/^(here are|the following|below are|these are|sure|certainly|okay|here's)\b/i.test(line)));
}

/** Cluster the intake by keyword overlap with an angle, returning the matching
 * source subjects in descending relevance (the newsroom's source-clustering
 * capability; used by the angle-assignment layer). */
export function clusterSources(angle: string, articles: readonly SyndicationItem[], sourceSubjects: readonly string[], max = 5): readonly string[] {
  const angleKeywords = keywordsOf(angle);
  return Object.freeze(articles
    .map((article, index) => ({
      source: sourceSubjects[index],
      score: keywordsOf(article.title).filter((word) => angleKeywords.includes(word)).length,
    }))
    .filter((candidate): candidate is { source: string; score: number } => candidate.score > 0 && !!candidate.source)
    .sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score)
    .slice(0, max)
    .map((candidate) => candidate.source));
}

// ---------- the newsroom SELECT seam ----------

/** The newsroom's selection: the assigned term IS the angle. Rather than the
 * farm's term-as-lens single-story pick, the newsroom clusters the intake by
 * keyword overlap with the angle — the best-matching item leads, the rest of
 * the cluster is the reporter's context (the papers the brief is grounded in).
 * With no keyword match it falls back to the intake order, so the cycle always
 * settles on a story. */
export const newsroomSelect: SelectStory = ({ term, items }) => {
  const angleKeywords = keywordsOf(term);
  const scored = items
    .map((item) => ({ item, score: keywordsOf(`${item.title} ${item.summary ?? ""}`).filter((word) => angleKeywords.includes(word)).length }))
    .sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score);
  const matched = scored.filter((entry) => entry.score > 0);
  const ranked = matched.length > 0 ? matched : scored;
  const story = ranked[0]?.item ?? items[0]!;
  const context = ranked.slice(1, 6).map((entry) => entry.item);
  return { story, context };
};

// ---------- claim-state writes (harvested from @emsenn/newsroom) ----------

/** The subject atom for a source observation: prefix + the article's id (arXiv
 * abs ids stripped to their bare form), or its url/title. */
export function articleSubject(prefix: string, article: Pick<SyndicationItem, "id" | "url" | "title">): string {
  const rawId = article.id ?? article.url ?? article.title;
  const arxivId = typeof article.id === "string" ? article.id.replace(/^https?:\/\/arxiv\.org\/abs\//, "") : rawId;
  return newsSlug(`${prefix} ${arxivId}`);
}

/** The source observation as a claim write: title and url, plus abstract,
 * publication date, authors, and categories when present. */
export function sourceWrites(article: SyndicationItem, opts: Readonly<{ prefix?: string; citation?: string }> = {}): readonly NewsClaimWrite[] {
  const prefix = opts.prefix ?? article.source ?? "source";
  const subject = articleSubject(prefix, article);
  const citation = opts.citation ?? article.url;
  const claims: Record<string, unknown> = { title: article.title, url: article.url };
  if (article.summary) claims["abstract"] = article.summary;
  if (article.published) claims["published"] = article.published;
  if (article.authors && article.authors.length > 0) claims["author"] = [...article.authors];
  if (article.categories && article.categories.length > 0) claims["category"] = [...article.categories];
  return Object.freeze([write(subject, claims, citation)]);
}

/** A brief as claim writes: the headline cell and (when present) the findings
 * cell, both cited to the reporter. */
export function briefWrites(subject: string, brief: StructuredBrief, citation = "newsroom:reporter"): readonly NewsClaimWrite[] {
  const writes: NewsClaimWrite[] = [write(subject, { headline: brief.headline }, citation)];
  if (brief.findings.length > 0) writes.push(write(subject, { finds: [...brief.findings] }, citation));
  return Object.freeze(writes);
}

// ---------- the newsroom RECORD seam ----------

/** The newsroom's witness: instead of a markdown candidate, the cycle's
 * settlement is carried out as a claim-state ASSERTION TRACE (the canonical
 * carrier — every source observation, the angle and its draws-on links, the
 * brief, and each editorial gate, charged) and the CLAIM SETS folded back out
 * of it. Per the news-topology theory the trace is canonical and prose is the
 * lossy projection. */
export type NewsroomCultivation = Readonly<{
  kind: "content.farm.newsroom-cultivation:witness";
  property: string;
  assignment: DemandEntry;
  story: SyndicationItem;
  draft: PostDraft;
  gates: readonly FarmGate[];
  shipped: boolean;
  assertionTrace: NewsAssertionTrace;
  claimSets: readonly NewsClaimSet[];
  path: string | null;
  usage: Readonly<{ calls: number; tokens: number }>;
  intakeObstructions: readonly string[];
}>;

/** The newsroom's recording: fold the settlement into claim writes — source
 * observations for the story and its context, the angle and its draws-on
 * links, the brief, the editorial gates (a failed gate is a denial), and the
 * published status when shipped — assert them into a trace, and fold the trace
 * back into per-subject claim sets. Persists the trace + claim sets as JSON
 * under the property's data dir unless dry-run. */
export const newsroomRecord: RecordCycle<NewsroomCultivation> = (settlement: CycleSettlement, ctx) => {
  const { property, assignment, story, context, draft, gates, shipped, usage, intakeObstructions } = settlement;
  const papers = [story, ...context];
  const subject = newsSlug(draft.title).split("-").slice(0, 9).join("-") || `${property.name}-${ctx.at}`;
  const citation = `newsroom:${property.name}`;
  const sourceSubjects = unique(papers.map((item) => articleSubject(item.source ?? "source", item)));
  const findings = sentences(draft.body);
  const writes: NewsClaimWrite[] = [
    ...papers.flatMap((item) => sourceWrites(item, { prefix: item.source ?? "source" })),
    write(subject, { angle: assignment.term, "draws-on": sourceSubjects }, citation),
    ...briefWrites(subject, { headline: draft.title, findings }, citation),
    ...gates.map((gate) => clearGate(subject, gate.gate, gate.charge === "pass", `desk:${gate.gate}`)),
    ...(shipped ? [write(subject, { status: "published", "published-at": ctx.at }, citation)] : []),
  ];
  const assertionTrace = assertionsFromWrites(writes, { transaction: ctx.at });
  const claimSets = claimSetsFromTrace(assertionTrace);
  let path: string | null = null;
  if (!ctx.dryRun) {
    const dir = join(property.dataDir, "newsroom");
    mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    path = join(dir, `${subject}.json`);
    writeFileSync(path, `${JSON.stringify({ subject, shipped, assertionTrace, claimSets })}\n`, "utf8");
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    kind: "content.farm.newsroom-cultivation:witness" as const,
    property: property.name,
    assignment,
    story,
    draft,
    gates,
    shipped,
    assertionTrace,
    claimSets,
    path,
    usage,
    intakeObstructions,
  });
};

// ---------- the newsroom CYCLE (the N-angles-per-run orchestration) ----------

/** Ask the assignment editor for the strongest distinct angles in today's
 * intake. The assignment is the OUTER layer of the newsroom fiber: it chooses
 * WHICH angles to run; the per-angle cultivation (selection → composition →
 * recording) is one base cycle each. With no `ask`, the lead titles stand in;
 * an empty result still yields a roundup angle so a non-empty intake always
 * produces at least one story. */
export async function assignAngles(
  voice: string,
  topic: string,
  items: readonly SyndicationItem[],
  max = 3,
  ask?: Ask,
): Promise<readonly string[]> {
  const reply = ask ? await ask(assignmentPrompt(voice, topic, items, max)) : items.slice(0, max).map((item) => item.title).join("\n");
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const angles: string[] = [];
  for (const angle of parseAngles(reply)) {
    const key = newsSlug(angle).split("-").slice(0, 8).join("-");
    if (!key || seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    angles.push(angle);
    if (angles.length >= max) break;
  }
  if (angles.length === 0 && items.length > 0) angles.push(`What's new in ${topic}`);
  return Object.freeze(angles);
}

/** Options for the newsroom cycle: the clock stamp, the beat to draw intake
 * from, the assignment topic and story bound, and the cultivation I/O. */
export type NewsroomCycleOptions = Readonly<{
  at: string;
  beat?: string;
  topic?: string;
  maxStories?: number;
  ask?: Ask;
  fetchImpl?: FetchLike;
  adapters?: Readonly<Record<string, SyndicationAdapter>>;
  dryRun?: boolean;
  provider?: string;
  model?: string;
  env?: Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>>;
}>;

/** One newsroom cycle for a property: fetch the beat's intake ONCE, assign the
 * day's angles over it, then run the base cultivation cycle once per angle with
 * the newsroom seams (angle selection, brief composition, assertion-trace
 * recording). The witnessed stories and the per-angle obstructions are both
 * returned as values. */
export type NewsroomCycleResult = Readonly<{
  kind: "content.farm.newsroom-cycle:witness";
  property: string;
  angles: readonly string[];
  intakeObstructions: readonly string[];
  stories: readonly NewsroomCultivation[];
  obstructions: readonly CultivationObstruction[];
}>;

/** Run one newsroom cycle. See NewsroomCycleResult. */
export async function runNewsroomCycle(property: FarmProperty, options: NewsroomCycleOptions): Promise<NewsroomCycleResult> {
  const beat = options.beat ?? Object.keys(property.beatSources)[0] ?? "";
  const intake = await intakeItems(property, beat, {
    ...(options.fetchImpl === undefined ? {} : { fetchImpl: options.fetchImpl }),
    ...(options.adapters === undefined ? {} : { adapters: options.adapters }),
  });
  const topic = options.topic ?? property.termKey ?? property.name;
  const voice = [...property.voice.persona, ...(property.voice.laws ?? [])].join(" ");
  const angles = await assignAngles(voice, topic, intake.items, options.maxStories ?? 3, options.ask);
  const stories: NewsroomCultivation[] = [];
  const obstructions: CultivationObstruction[] = [];
  for (const angle of angles) {
    const result = await cultivate(property, {
      at: options.at,
      term: angle,
      beat,
      items: intake.items,
      ...(options.ask === undefined ? {} : { ask: options.ask }),
      ...(options.dryRun === undefined ? {} : { dryRun: options.dryRun }),
      ...(options.provider === undefined ? {} : { provider: options.provider }),
      ...(options.model === undefined ? {} : { model: options.model }),
      ...(options.env === undefined ? {} : { env: options.env }),
      select: newsroomSelect,
      compose: newsroomCompose,
      record: newsroomRecord,
    });
    if (result.kind === "content.farm.newsroom-cultivation:witness") stories.push(result);
    else obstructions.push(result);
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    kind: "content.farm.newsroom-cycle:witness" as const,
    property: property.name,
    angles,
    intakeObstructions: intake.obstructions,
    stories: Object.freeze(stories),
    obstructions: Object.freeze(obstructions),
  });
}

type FetchLike = typeof fetch;

export type ContentProviderName = "groq" | "nim";

export type ContentProvider = Readonly<{
  url: string;
  keyEnv: string;
  model: string;
}>;

export type ContentProviderUsage = Readonly<{
  promptTokens?: number;
  completionTokens?: number;
  totalTokens?: number;
  raw?: unknown;
}>;

export type ContentAskOptions = Readonly<{
  provider?: ContentProviderName | string;
  providers?: Readonly<Record<string, ContentProvider>>;
  model?: string;
  temperature?: number;
  maxTokens?: number;
  env?: Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>>;
  fetchImpl?: FetchLike;
  onUsage?: (usage: ContentProviderUsage, meta: Readonly<{ provider: string; model: string }>) => void;
}>;

/**
 * The default provider registry. `nim` is the default-capable provider;
 * `groq` only suits prompts well under 8k tokens (tiny context window).
 */
export const contentProviders: Readonly<Record<string, ContentProvider>> = Object.freeze({
  groq: Object.freeze({ url: "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions", keyEnv: "GROQ_API_KEY", model: "llama-3.1-8b-instant" }),
  nim: Object.freeze({ url: "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/chat/completions", keyEnv: "NVIDIA_API_KEY", model: "meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct" }),
});

function envValue(env: Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>>, key: string): string | undefined {
  const value = env[key];
  return value === "" ? undefined : value;
}

/** Whether a provider is configured AND keyed in the given environment.
 *  Boolean convenience at the app edge (invariant A1 reserves carriers for
 *  lib judgments; an app may answer configuration questions plainly). */
export function hasProvider(provider: string, opts: Pick<ContentAskOptions, "providers" | "env"> = {}): boolean {
  const providers = opts.providers ?? contentProviders;
  const config = providers[provider];
  return !!(config && envValue(opts.env ?? process.env, config.keyEnv));
}

/** First keyed provider in preference order; nim leads (see module note). */
export function pickProvider(order: readonly string[] = ["nim", "groq"], opts: Pick<ContentAskOptions, "providers" | "env"> = {}): string | null {
  return order.find((provider) => hasProvider(provider, opts)) ?? null;
}

function normalizeProviderUsage(value: unknown): ContentProviderUsage {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return Object.freeze({ raw: value });
  const usage = value as { prompt_tokens?: unknown; completion_tokens?: unknown; total_tokens?: unknown };
  const promptTokens = typeof usage.prompt_tokens === "number" ? usage.prompt_tokens : undefined;
  const completionTokens = typeof usage.completion_tokens === "number" ? usage.completion_tokens : undefined;
  const totalTokens = typeof usage.total_tokens === "number" ? usage.total_tokens : undefined;
  const normalized: { promptTokens?: number; completionTokens?: number; totalTokens?: number; raw?: unknown } = { raw: value };
  if (promptTokens !== undefined) normalized.promptTokens = promptTokens;
  if (completionTokens !== undefined) normalized.completionTokens = completionTokens;
  if (totalTokens !== undefined) normalized.totalTokens = totalTokens;
  return Object.freeze(normalized);
}

/**
 * Close over one provider configuration and return the ask morphism.
 * Defaults to `nim`, the default-capable provider; pass `provider: "groq"`
 * only for prompts well under 8k tokens. Throws only on malformed
 * configuration (unknown provider, unkeyed environment) — transport
 * failures surface per call.
 */
export function makeAsk(options: ContentAskOptions = {}): (prompt: string) => Promise<string> {
  const providerName = options.provider ?? "nim";
  const providers = options.providers ?? contentProviders;
  const provider = providers[providerName];
  if (!provider) throw new TypeError(`unknown provider "${providerName}"`);
  const key = envValue(options.env ?? process.env, provider.keyEnv);
  if (!key) throw new TypeError(`${provider.keyEnv} is not set`);
  const model = options.model ?? provider.model;
  const fetchImpl = options.fetchImpl ?? fetch;
  const temperature = options.temperature ?? 0.4;
  return async (prompt: string): Promise<string> => {
    const response = await fetchImpl(provider.url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", authorization: `Bearer ${key}` },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model,
        messages: [{ role: "user", content: String(prompt) }],
        temperature,
        ...(options.maxTokens === undefined ? {} : { max_tokens: options.maxTokens }),
      }),
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`${providerName} ${model}: HTTP ${response.status}`);
    const data = await response.json() as { usage?: unknown; choices?: readonly { message?: { content?: unknown } }[] };
    options.onUsage?.(normalizeProviderUsage(data.usage), { provider: providerName, model });
    return String(data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content ?? "");
  };
}
